fee_notes: No traditional royalty or marketing/ad fund fee. Instead, a tiered 'Service Fee' is charged on Annual Gross Sales of Approved Winzer Products and Franchisee Products: 16% on sales under $200,000; 14% on $200,000–$349,999; 12% on $350,000–$499,999; 10% on $500,000–$749,999; 9% on $750,000–$999,999; 8% on sales exceeding $1,000,000. Fee is deducted from Periodic Gross Profits each Billing Period (2–3 per month). Software fee currently $0 but possibly $50–$100/month per user under certain conditions. No local, regional, or national advertising cooperative required.
raw_excerpt: Service Fee | 8% - 16% on sales of Approved Winzer Products and Franchisee Products | At the time of Periodic Gross Profits payment | 16% on Annual Gross Sales, reduced to 14% if Annual Gross Sales are $200,000 to $349,000, reduced to 12% if Annual Gross Sales are $350,000 to $499,999; reduced to 10% if Annual Gross Sales are $500,000 to $749,999; reduced to 9% if Annual Gross Sales are $750,000 to $999,999; and reduced to 8% if Annual Gross sales exceed $1,000,000. | Software Fee | Currently $0, but possibly $50 to $100 per month per user
